title: WhatsApp starts letting users schedule messages from 10 minutes to 14 days in advance, in group and individual chats; messages are sent even if the phone is off (Ivan Mehta/TechCrunch)
summary: Ivan Mehta / TechCrunch: WhatsApp starts letting users schedule messages from 10 minutes to 14 days in advance, in group and individual chats; messages are sent even if the phone is off — WhatsApp on Wednesday started rolling out a much-sought-after feature: the ability to schedule messages in both individual and group chats.
